subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **"paid."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Paid"** is the correct past tense verb to use in this context.
 
• It means to give somebody money for work, goods, services, etc. (किसी काम, सामान, सेवा आदि के लिए भुगतान करना)
 
 
• **Example**: *She is very well **paid**__.*
 
 
 
• The sentence suggests that someone owed money and has now given it.
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.
 
• Correct sentence: 

Workers' compensation benefits in Pennsylvania should pay for your medical __bills__ and a portion of your lost wages. However, you cannot be __paid__ for pain and suffering or other non-financial damages that your illness or injury may ______ (3) ______ you. A personal injury or wrongful death lawsuit, on the other hand, ______ (4) ______ compensation for the ill worker or surviving family members. If someone ______ (5) ______ your employer or a co-worker was to blame for your illness, you could pursue such a claim.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **"Repudiated"** means to reject or deny something, like a claim or responsibility. (खंडन करना, किसी बात को स्‍वीकार करने या मानने से इनकार करना)
 
• **"Stiffed" **means to not pay what is owed, especially as a deliberate act of dishonesty. (बकाया राशि का भुगतान न करना, विशेष रूप से जानबूझकर बेईमानी के कार्य के रूप में)
 
• **"Signed" **refers to putting a signature on something, like a document or agreement. (पत्र, दस्‍तावेज़ आदि पर हस्‍ताक्षर करना (यह बताने के लिए कि इसे आपने लिखा है और जो लिखा है उससे आप सहमत हैं))
